message.content: Triage initiated — shrinking the reported energy violation to isolate the cause.
Shrunk to a minimal reproducing case — now tracing the energy spike step by step.
The trace confirms runaway energy growth after high-speed bounces — now verifying the trigger with a single-parameter fix.

function.arguments: {"scenario_id":"sc453aa1937","rule":"energy_bound","explanation":"Shrunk scenario shows a single elastic body (e=1) launched upward at ~40 m/s from y=11.6 with dt≈0.0287 and gravity 9.81. It collides with the top boundary within step 1 (vy flips +40.47 to -40.73, substeps 40). Mechanical energy should be conserved (or decrease) in free flight and stay constant across an e=1 bounce, but energy rises each step: 971.9 (step0) →973.07 (step1) →1031.70 (step2) →1092.71 (step3), exceeding the allowed 1074.16 (E0+10%+5J). The top-wall impulse / positional correction combined with semi-implicit Euler integration and large substep count adds spurious kinetic energy on the high-speed elastic bounce instead of conserving it. With gravity still accelerating the body downward thereafter, the inflated kinetic energy persists and grows, breaching energy_bound by step 3. Changing only e to 0 removes elastic energy amplification and the violation disappears.","citations":[{"body":-1,"claim":"initial mechanical energy at step 0 before any bounce","field":"energy","step":0,"value":971.9650861523842},{"body":-1,"claim":"energy after top-wall bounce at step1 already slightly above initial, speed increased 41.42 to 41.68 despite e=1 should conserve","field":"energy","step":1,"value":973.0734961327004},{"body":-1,"claim":"energy continues to climb at step2","field":"energy","step":2,"value":1031.700880853557},{"body":-1,"claim":"first energy_bound violation at step3: energy 1092.71 exceeds allowed 1074.16 (E0 971.96)","field":"energy","step":3,"value":1092.7144060268051}],"counterfactual":{"change":"Changed one field: bodies[0].e from 1.0 to 0.0 (perfectly inelastic). Elastic bounce no longer amplifies energy; with otherwise identical dt, gravity, velocity and steps the run stays within energy bound.","scenario_id":"s3b6d844323"}}
